messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — during onboarding calls with HelioHealth we heard the same three asks across 4 sessions. Concerned these are becoming blockers for adoption/renewal. cc @Aisha @Devon

Devon (PM): can you paste the asks? rough prioritization is fine.

Maya (CS): yep — short list below. I also attached a CSV to the ticket but pasting here so it's easy to triage:

Maya (CS): 1) Route-level cost breakdown in Console (customers want per-route billing in UI, currently export-only) — impact: billing ops + ROI story — multiple customers asked.
Maya (CS): 2) Granular role-based controls for model rollouts (allow product managers to limit model variants per team) — impact: security/compliance concerns for PHI projects.
Maya (CS): 3) Improve streaming reconnect resiliency for mobile SDKs (sessions drop on flaky networks) — impact: demo reliability and dev experience.

Aisha (Product): thanks, this is helpful. From product POV: 1 is a visibility/cost feature that maps to revenue ops asks (medium-high effort), 2 is access control + rollout which touches RBAC & Console UX (high effort), 3 is SDK/runtime reliability (engineering-focused, could be medium effort but high trust ROI).

Devon (PM): My take: 3 should be queued as a bug/regression sprint candidate — high ROI for demos. 1 could be an "experiments" milestone (show per-route data in beta). 2 is strategic but bigger — needs scoping and legal/security signoff.

Leo (CS): I can follow up with HelioHealth next week to get exact use-cases for 1 & 2. Quick ask: does Product want the customer-facing language or is tagging as "billing"/"rbac" sufficient for the board?

Aisha (Product): Tagging is fine to start. If we add to roadmap we will ask for a customer brief. Please capture one example quote for each ask.

Sarah (AE): FYI renewal w/ HelioHealth is 2025-02-15 — they mentioned budget sensitivity. If we don't show clear ROI for cost transparency they might push.

Maya (CS): noted. I'll capture quotes and the billing export sample. sending short CSV snippet here for triage:

Maya (CS): ```
customer,ask,impact,example_quote
HelioHealth,per-route-billing,finance-team needs line items,"We can't reconcile platform spend without per-route lines"
HelioHealth,rbac-rollouts,security wants scoping,"Need to restrict model variants for PHI endpoints"
HelioHealth,streaming-reconnect,mobile app reliability,"Stream drops on poor cellular — demo fails"
```

feedback-bot: Auto-summary created and tagged: [billing_visibility, rbac, sdk_reliability]. Linked issue: PROD-Triage-547.

Devon (PM): cool. I'll create an umbrella ticket and assign initial priorities: SDK reliability -> P2, Per-route billing -> P2, RBAC rollout -> P3 for now.

Aisha (Product): can someone add these to the weekly roadmap sync agenda? I want to see HelioHealth quotes before we commit.

Leo (CS): I'll add to the agenda and drop the customer quotes before Tue standup.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. Action items: Maya capture quotes + upload export sample; Leo add to roadmap agenda; Devon open umbrella ticket PROD-Triage-547 and assign; Aisha to review and escalate if legal/security needed. :thumbsup:

Sarah (AE): +1. I'll prep renewal note for CSM handoff if we make roadmap movement.

Maya (CS): looping back later this week with quotes. :eyes:
